body.summary: PLAN4 rework in progress: T1–T3 passed. T4 protects descendants while root0700 survives actual native exclusive publication, then seals/fsyncs/strictly verifies before success under original ownership. Exact root-only offline recovery is permitted; sealed-root mutation is refused, and verified sealed reuse reconfirms namespace durability without mode/byte changes. Typed uncertainty retains canonical and stage evidence. Focused native, recovery, failed/successful durability-retry, stale/conflicting-owner and cleanup cases passed; the prior registered T4 source passed all11 cases before these final retry guards. T5–T10, full scoped regression and current macOS/Linux VM qualification remain pending before final Story BUILD approval.
